title: setup instructions --yes creates AGENTS.md holding the JITSO block, marked added=new
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). In a project with no instruction file, `jitso setup instructions --yes` creates `AGENTS.md` with the JITSO block (BEGIN line with `block=1 added=new`, the text, END line) and one line break after it, and previews it as a new file. No backup is made, because nothing existed. `CLAUDE.md` is not created.
